sentences.en: There was something quite special, almost sinister to his smile.
sentences.zh: 他的笑容有些特别，几乎带有一种不祥之兆的感觉。

sentences.en: Yanni's eyes were deranged and he had a sinister smile.
sentences.zh: 亚尼的眼睛疯癫异常，他露出了一个险恶的笑容。

sentences.en: Dan had that sinister feeling that something was wrong.
sentences.zh: 丹有种不详的预感，觉得有什么不对劲。

senses.zh: 邪恶的，不祥的；<古>（纹章）（在）盾形纹章左侧的
